Notes: Delta Staff 2.0.0 - The Next Chapter. Adds secure Microsoft sign-in, live Arbor behaviour recording, class and form student tiles, multi-student positive points, and background submission so staff can continue working while Arbor processes records. C2, C2T and C3 now feed the On-Call Command Centre as behaviour incidents with purpose-built response stages instead of approval and denial prompts. Behaviour incidents no longer open the ordinary request popup on staff computers. Existing alerts, Staff Hub, timetables, duties, buses, cover, form challenge and automatic updates are retained.
